concept: Organizations consolidated billing: single bill and RI/SP sharing
tests: Knowing consolidated billing features: a single bill, aggregated usage volume, and sharing of RI/Savings Plans discounts (choose two).
expected: AWS Organizations with consolidated billing + keep RI/Savings Plan discount sharing enabled. Triggers: "many accounts", "single bill", "reach volume discounts faster", "unused commitment benefits other accounts".
why_not: Separate Savings Plans with sharing disabled is the opposite of the goal; Budgets only alert and do not combine bills.
